Danaida - Free Pixel Animated Monsters Pack 16x16
Source: https://danaida.itch.io/free-pixel-monsters-pack-16x16
Author: Danaida

License (as stated by the author):
- Free for personal and commercial use.
- Use and edit freely.
- Do not redistribute or resell the assets as an asset pack.
- Can be used in game development and other productions.

The PNGs in this folder are 6 selected monsters, extracted from the public preview sheet
for integration testing in this project. If the full pack is later downloaded, replace
these frames with the original files from the pack.
